verdict_a.evidence: Observer joins actual tool_results POST metadata to exact delegated call + opening conversation; checks successful body fields/current URL/stage terms, response resolved fingerprint, subsequent resume terminal success, and strict same-conversation follow-up. 577 evidence is pre-fix; no post-fix native claim.

findings: Response contract in src/lib/api/routes/tool-results.ts declares resolved, already_resolved, not_found, continuation_needed, user_request_id, conversation_id; observer accepts a response with resolved array and missing not_found because it defaults missing not_found to []. Require not_found array (or otherwise validate the actual contract) to reject malformed HTTP-200 bodies.
strengths: Wrong tool/call/conversation, error/output/current-URL/content, failed/missing acknowledgement, resume and terminal failures are tested; payloads are fingerprinted/sanitized; URL and text are not retained.

test_assessment: Synthetic observer seam covers transport parsing and joins, with reported old-source RED, mutant RED, and green suite. It is not post-fix native proof; do not mark native acceptance complete.
